d: Anant Singh ki beti Shivangi ki shadi men umri bhari bhir aur khane ke pandal men huee avyavastha ko lekar lagatar saval uth rahe hain. soshal midiya par aise vidiyo vayral hue, jinmen mehmanon ko plet ki jagah gatte aur dibbon men khana lete dekha gaya. khane ke kauntar par bhi aphra-taphri ke drishy samne aae.
